message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
It looks like my initial list of times didn't work for Elena and David. Brad has sent me a new list of times to check against Priya's and Marcus's calendars. I need to go through this new list and see if any of these times work for Priya and Marcus.

Here's Brad's list:
*   Mon: 11:00, 11:30
*   Tue: 09:00, 09:30
*   Wed: 13:00, 13:30
*   Thu: 09:30, 14:30, 15:00
*   Fri: 15:00, 15:30

I'll check these against the calendars I have access to.

**Monday, Nov 16:**
*   Brad's proposed slots: 11:00, 11:30
*   Priya's availability: Busy from 11:00-12:00 (Travel, Contract review)
*   Marcus's availability: Busy at 11:30 (Busy)
*   Outcome: No match.

**Tuesday, Nov 17:**
*   Brad's proposed slots: 09:00, 09:30
*   Priya's availability: Busy from 09:00-10:00 (Board prep, Partner lunch)
*   Marcus's availability: Busy from 09:00-10:00 (Recruiting call, Litigation strategy)
*   Outcome: No match.

**Wednesday, Nov 18:**
*   Brad's proposed slots: 13:00, 13:30
*   Priya's availability: Busy at 13:00 (Client call), 13:30 (Client dinner prep)
*   Marcus's availability: Busy at 13:00 (Partner lunch), 13:30 (Litigation strategy)
*   Outcome: No match.

**Thursday, Nov 19:**
*   Brad's proposed slots: 09:30, 14:30, 15:00
*   Priya's availability: Busy at 09:30 (Busy), free at 14:30, busy at 15:00 (Client dinner prep)
*   Marcus's availability: Busy at 09:30 (Contract review), busy at 14:30 (Dentist appointment), busy at 15:00 (Board prep)
*   Outcome: No match.

**Friday, Nov 20:**
*   Brad's proposed slots: 15:00, 15:30
*   Priya's availability: Busy at 15:00 (Hiring panel), 15:30 (Contract review)
*   Marcus's availability: Busy at 15:00 (Travel), 15:30 (Busy)
*   Outcome: No match.

It seems none of the times Brad proposed work for Priya and Marcus. This is getting tricky. I need to find a new approach.

Instead of proposing lists of times, it might be more efficient to share the full availability of the partners I can see. This way, Brad can do the comparison on his end.

I'll compile the complete free slots for Priya and Marcus and post them to the workspace.

**Priya's Free Slots:**
*   Mon: 09:00-10:00, 13:00-14:00
*   Tue: 10:30-11:00, 13:00-14:00, 14:30-15:00, 16:30-17:00
*   Wed: 12:30-13:00, 15:00-16:00
*   Thu: 09:00-09:30, 10:00-10:30, 13:00-13:30, 14:30-15:00
*   Fri: 11:00-12:00, 13:00-13:30, 14:00-14:30

**Marcus's Free Slots:**
*   Mon: 09:00-10:00, 11:00-11:30, 15:00-15:30
*   Tue: 11:00-11:30, 13:00-14:00, 15:30-16:00, 16:30-17:00
*   Wed: 09:00-09:30, 12:00-12:30, 14:00-14:30, 15:00-16:00
*   Thu: 10:00-10:30, 12:00-12:30
*   Fri: 11:00-12:00, 14:30-15:00

Now I will find the common free slots again, to be sure.

*   Mon: 9:00-10:00 (9:00, 9:30)
*   Tue: 13:00-14:00 (13:00, 13:30), 16:30-17:00 (16:30)
*   Wed: 15:00-16:00 (15:00, 15:30)
*   Thu: 10:00-10:30 (10:00)
*   Fri: 11:00-12:00 (11:00, 11:30)

I was right the first time. I will inform Brad that none of his proposed slots work and provide him with my initial list of common availabilities again. This seems to be the only way forward. Maybe he missed something. I will also ask him to provide the list of common availabilities for Elena and David.<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Brad's proposed times don't work. I need to communicate this to him and figure out a new plan. Instead of sending lists back and forth, it would be more efficient if we both shared the full availability of the partners we can see. This will allow us to see all the possible overlaps.

I've already compiled the list of common free slots for Priya and Marcus. I'll post that to the workspace and ask Brad to do the same for Elena and David. This way, we can see all the information in one place and find a solution.

My new plan is:
1.  Inform Brad that none of his suggested times work.
2.  Share the complete list of common free slots for Priya and Marcus again.
3.  Ask Brad to provide the complete list of common free slots for Elena and David.
4.  Once I have that information, I can find a time that works for all four.
5.  Book the meeting.
6.  Inform Brad so he can send the confirmation.

I'll start by crafting a message to Brad in the workspace. </SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>

function.name: append_workspace
function.arguments:
{"text":"Hi Brad. Thanks for checking. I've reviewed the times you suggested, and unfortunately, none of them work for Priya and Marcus.

To make this easier, let's share the full availability of the partners we can see. Here are all the 30-minute slots when Priya and Marcus are both free:

Mon: 09:00, 09:30
Tue: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
Wed: 15:00, 15:30
Thu: 10:00
Fri: 11:00, 11:30

Could you please provide a similar list of all the times when Elena and David are both free? That way we can find an overlap."}
